original.prompt: Consider the following statements about the NITI Aayog report on school education released in May 2026:
items: Government schools make up 68.1% of all schools in India.
Private schools make up 38.8% of all schools in India.
Only 5.4% of schools offer continuous education from Grade 1 to 12.
original.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
original.explain: Statement 2 is wrong: private schools are 23.1% of institutions, and 38.8% is their share of enrolment. Government schools, though 68.1% of all schools, now enrol only 49.24% of students, down from 71% in 2005.
original.source: Private schools, at 23.1% of institutions, now account for 38.8% of enrolment.
